title: Lively Sour Argentinian Jalapeno Quesadilla
description: A tangy twist on traditional quesadillas, featuring the bold flavors of argentinian cuisine. This dish combines the spice of jalapenos with the brightness of yuzu-cure, making it a standout snack or light lunch option.

ingredients.name: tortillas
ingredients.notes: corn or flour, 8 inches in diameter

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together yuzu-cure and sliced jalapenos, let it sit for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat, about 375F.
Place a tortilla in the skillet, sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla, and top with sliced jalapenos.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose filling, cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
